notes: Duplicate scan mein ab har Page ki apni progress dikhti hai — naam, progress bar aur percent ke sath har Page ki halat (Queue / Scan ho raha hai / Ho gaya / Skipped) live nazar ati hai. Scan ko beech mein Pause, Resume aur Stop karne ke designed buttons bhi shamil hain — ruka hua scan wahin se aage barhta hai, aur Stop par jo scan ho chuka ho wohi mehfooz rehta hai.
